# Repurpose a Winner

Your best post, reworked into fresh angles.

Use for reworking their own best-performing post into new angles. Not for rewriting text they paste.

**The user might say:** "Find my best-performing standalone post from the last 90 days and rework it into three fresh angles. Reuse the principle, not the wording."

## Steps

1. Their best posts of the last 90 days.
   ```sh
   xholic analytics content --range 90d --sort engagements --limit 10
   ```
2. Pick the best standalone post (not a reply).
3. Check what the user's Workers already wrote: ready-made drafts, free to use.
   ```sh
   xholic workers drafts
   ```
4. Get material in the user's voice (proven posts, their winners, saves).
   ```sh
   xholic context writing-kit --topic "<the winner's subject>"
   ```
5. Write the posts yourself from that material: one idea each, the user's voice, no links, no facts that aren't in the data.
6. Check every draft before showing it; fix what it flags.
   ```sh
   xholic drafts check --text "<post>" --source-text "<post it was built from>"
   ```
7. Write three fresh angles: reuse the principle, never the wording. Pass the winner as --source-text to catch near-copies.
8. Only when the user says so: save it as a draft (`xholic drafts save --text ...`) or schedule it (`xholic posts schedule --text ... --scheduled-at 2026-11-03T09:00 --timezone <their tz> --idempotency-key <unique>`). A draft is not a post.
